youth_club_leagues.reason: ESPN does not cover domestic or continental youth club leagues (e.g. UEFA Youth League, Division de Honor Juvenil). Only international youth tournaments (FIFA U20, UEFA Euro U21) exist.

reserves_second_teams.reason: Reserve teams (MLS Next Pro, Argentine Torneo Proyeccion, Spain Primera RFEF/Castilla) are not indexed as independent leagues. Stripping reserve suffixes causes catastrophic false matches to senior parent teams.

scandinavia_lower.reason: Sweden only covers Allsvenskan (swe.1). Superettan (swe.2) returns empty directory. Finland has 0 coverage.

baltics.reason: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania have 0 domestic league coverage on ESPN. Clubs only appear if they qualify for UEFA continental rounds.

limitations.trap_01_waf_user_agent_signature: site.api.espn.com blocks truncated 'Mozilla/5.0' and 'Wget' with 403. Default python-requests, curl/8.x, and full browser UAs (Mozilla/5.0 Windows NT...) pass with 200.
limitations.trap_02_search_punctuation_lucene_break: Punctuation such as slashes (Bodo/Glimt) in Web Search API breaks Solr/Lucene query parser and returns 0 items. Must strip punctuation and use clean tokens.
limitations.trap_03_duplicate_athlete_ids: ESPN maintains duplicate IDs for same player (e.g. Mika Stojsavljevic 14877 active vs 12347 stub 404; Lucia Cortez Llorca 10678 active vs 5092 stub; Ruth Roura Llaverias 16206 active vs 11795 stub). Search v3 often returns the stub first; Search v2 returns both.
limitations.trap_04_tennis_inverted_homeaway_order: 100% of tennis matches in ESPN scoreboard return competitors in ('away', 'home') list order. Blindly indexing competitors[0] as home results in 100% backwards attribution. Must sort by competitor.homeAway == 'home'.
limitations.trap_05_tennis_tournament_date_drift: In tennis, event.date is the tournament start date (e.g. 2026-08-24 for US Open), while competition.date is the actual match kickoff (e.g. 2026-09-10T23:00Z). Using event.date corrupts date matching.
limitations.trap_06_youth_and_reserve_name_stripping: Naive normalization stripping U19/U21/II/B/Reserves causes youth fixtures to collapse onto senior parent clubs (e.g. Barcelona U19 -> Barcelona ID 83). Resolver must require youth/reserve congruence.
limitations.trap_07_tennis_missing_summary_endpoint: /summary?event={id} returns HTTP 400 for tennis. Match scores and tie-breaks must be read from /scoreboard linescores.
limitations.trap_08_absence_of_xg_and_coordinates: ESPN football summary does not calculate or return Expected Goals (xG) or pitch coordinates in plays array.
limitations.trap_09_core_api_pagination_parameter: Core API uses 'page=N' (1-indexed) for page navigation. 'pageIndex=N' is silently ignored and stays on page 1. Maximum limit is 1000.
limitations.trap_10_dead_league_directories: Out of 218 discovered football leagues, only 88 return active team directories. The rest return HTTP 200 with empty teams: [].
limitations.trap_11_vsathlete_endpoint_absence: Core API /athletes/{id}/vsathlete/{opp_id} returns HTTP 404 for tennis. H2H records must be synthesized locally from eventlogs.
limitations.trap_12_football_penalty_shootouts: In knockout matches, score reflects regulation+ET score (e.g. 0-0), while shootout goals are recorded in shootoutScore (e.g. 5 vs 3) and status is STATUS_FINAL_PEN.
limitations.trap_13_tennis_walkovers_and_retirements: STATUS_WALKOVER carries null linescores. Treating 0 games as completed match corrupts UNDER total games models. Must check status.type.name != 'STATUS_FINAL'.
limitations.trap_14_generic_club_token_overnormaliza: Stripping generic tokens like 'United' or 'City' turns Manchester United and Manchester City into identical tokens.
limitations.trap_15_timezone_date_rollover: Matches scheduled at 23:00 UTC cross midnight into the next calendar day in Central/Eastern Europe. Date matchers must allow +/- 1 day window.
